What are the three highest mountains, and how tall is each?
How do you purify water in the wild, step by step?

• Under any answer, open 🧩. The Cards row already says what it can draw: "A chart of 3 numbers", "A checklist of 5 steps".
• Create a card draws it at once, from the answer's own text, with no second model run: a chart, a table, a checklist, a comparison or key facts.
• The card sits under the answer. When more than one shape fits, switch between them; a pie only for parts of a whole, a line only for years in order.
• Tick the steps of a checklist; the ticks are kept with the chat.
• Add to Press takes the card along with the answer, into the PDF and the Markdown.
• Nothing to draw? Ask BOAR to make one. It is slower, and its card is still checked against the answer: a number or name that isn't there is left out.
• Nothing for health or seed-phrase questions.
A chat answer is being written. Try again when it ends.
